description: This file contains tests for the encryption service, including encryption/decryption correctness, handling of edge cases, configuration value encryption, and key derivation consistency. It is specifically focused on testing the functionality of encryption and decryption methods within the service.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_Roundtrip
methods.description: Tests that data encrypted and then decrypted returns to the original plaintext, validating the core encrypt/decrypt cycle.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_EmptyString
methods.description: Verifies encrypting and decrypting an empty string behaves as expected.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_DifferentNonces
methods.description: Checks that encrypting the same plaintext multiple times results in different ciphertexts due to nonce use, and that both decrypt correctly.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_WrongKey
methods.description: Ensures decryption fails when trying to decrypt ciphertext with an incorrect key.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_InvalidCiphertext
methods.description: Tests decryption with invalid base64 ciphertext, expecting a decoding error.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_CorruptedData
methods.description: Tests decryption failure when ciphertext data is corrupted or tampered with.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptDecrypt_TooShort
methods.description: Checks that ciphertext too short to contain a valid nonce triggers an error.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Verifies that configuration values marked as secrets are encrypted, and non-secret values remain unchanged.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_DecryptConfigurationValues
methods.description: Ensures secret configuration values are properly decrypted back to original.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptConfigurationValues_NonStringValue
methods.description: Confirms non-string secret values are left unchanged during encryption.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_EncryptConfigurationValues_MissingField
methods.description: Verifies behavior when specified secret fields are missing from the config.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_DecryptConfigurationValues_InvalidCiphertext
methods.description: Tests failure case when encrypted config fields contain invalid ciphertext.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_KeyDerivation_Consistency
methods.description: Checks that encrypt/decrypt works consistently with the same passphrase across different service instances.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_KeyDerivation_DifferentPassphrases
methods.description: Ensures decryption fails when ciphertext is decrypted with a different passphrase.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_LongPlaintext
methods.description: Tests encryption and decryption of long plaintext data.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_SpecialCharacters
methods.description: Verifies handling of plaintext containing special characters.

methods.name: TestEncryptionService_Unicode
methods.description: Ensures Unicode characters are properly encrypted and decrypted.
